test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

SMUDGE
solution: The correct answer is 'stain'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Smudge is a noun which means a blurred or smeared mark on the surface of something (किसी चीज की सतह पर धुंधला या धुंधला निशान।). • Example - There was a faint **smudge** of scarlet below the pressure lock. • The meaning of the given options are as follows - • stain - a colored patch or dirty mark that is difficult to remove. (एक रंगीन पैच या गंदा निशान जिसे हटाना मुश्किल है।) • sweet - having the pleasant taste characteristic of sugar or honey; not salt, sour, or bitter. (चीनी या शहद के सुखद स्वाद की विशेषता होना; नमक, खट्टा या कड़वा नहीं।) • trash - waste material; refuse. (कचरा) • mud - soft, sticky matter resulting from the mixing of earth and water. (कीचड़) • From the above meanings it is evident that **stain **is the **correct synonym** for the word **smudge**. 30:T62d, The correct answer is **'increased'. **
